description: A forward operating base commander must schedule a quarterly communications-equipment audit in one of two available facilities and publish the access and power-control actions needed to conduct it without interruption.

shared_context.S1: The quarterly communications-equipment audit must be completed Wednesday in either the Comms Annex or the Admin Hall.
shared_context.S2: Both facilities are normally available to authorized audit personnel, and Col. Hart issues the final facility and schedule order.
shared_context.S3: The base access desk and facilities control room need the final audit location and timing before Tuesday's close of business.
shared_context.S4: At the routine Wednesday-ahead coordination huddle, Col. Hart asks the signal and facilities officers to report any updates affecting the audit before the order is published.

PF1.text: Maj. Okafor confirmed with the audit team this morning that the audit requires exactly four uninterrupted hours and a dedicated UPS-backed circuit for the entire period; the requirement is in the team's technical checklist but has not yet been added to the commander's planning slide.

PF2.text: CWO Ramirez confirmed this morning that the Comms Annex's UPS circuit will be unavailable from 1000 to 1200 for a scheduled generator load test, while the Admin Hall's UPS circuit A is available continuously from 1300 to 1700; the facilities schedule has not yet been posted to the coordination board.

acceptance_conditions: The audit must be assigned to the Admin Hall.
Admin Hall UPS circuit A must be designated for the audit.
The access roster must be updated for the audit personnel.
The plan must include an uninterrupted-audit control commitment.
The signal officer's audit-duration requirement must be cited as justification.

content_checks.C6: any(c['type'] == 'uninterrupted_audit_control' and c['target'] == 'Admin Hall' for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: The exact four-hour requirement changes the audit end time to 1700 when it starts at 1300 and requires an explicit uninterrupted-audit control commitment.
The generator-test blackout makes the Comms Annex unusable during the needed period and changes the facility, start time, and power designation to Admin Hall at 1300 on UPS circuit A.
